action.label: server-controlled bounded display text
action.issued_revision: provenance integer; need not equal current revision
action.fit_note: optional server-owned catalogue explanation, at most600characters; also returned on command.recipe

notes: No returned state; do not accept() resolver output as a state refresh.
Malformed, foreign, deleted or compacted origin fails validation.

intake_arguments.values.origin: Pass source.origin unchanged for preview and prepare; both open_recipe and open_intake origins accepted.
intake_arguments.values.generation_id: Pass source.generation_id or ordinary generated card generation_id when present.
notes: Origin and generation remain in proposal and are revalidated at apply.
Neither field is copied into diary entry.
Other ordinary catalog/product editor calls remain compatible without these optional fields.

rendering: Render durable state.chat actions, not top-level response extras.
Status updates can occur when revision changes without message text changes.
Do not retarget using active thread or current selected recipe.
message_id and response_thread_id accompany persisted replies and replays.
New topic selection remains active when an older request completes.
Display catalogue fit_note to explain partial matches; action.fit_note is available inline and command.recipe.fit_note after resolution.
lifetime: Clear increments topic epoch; delete removes topic; old completion cannot resurrect either.
Pending proposals retain existing expiry/revision safety review rules after clear/delete.
Generated availability uses candidate-set identity and canonical draft presence; no invented draft TTL.
Current menu route is navigation; historical full unaccepted menu drafts are not copied into message storage.
